project_info.theme: iPhone 17 Pro Max dark editorial product launch
project_info.color_palette: Near-black, charcoal, titanium gray, warm skin tones, restrained white

main_subject.detail: A glamorous brunette woman in a black velvet deep-V dress holds a dark titanium iPhone 17 Pro Max upright beside her face; the rear camera cluster and a luminous display reflection are clearly visible.
main_subject.style: Hyperreal commercial beauty photography blended with a sparse premium feature sheet

composition_elements.text: Apple; iPhone 17 Pro Max; Titanium. So strong. So Pro.; A19 Pro chip.; 48MP Pro Camera system.; All-day battery life.; 6.9" Super Retina XDR display with ProMotion.; Built for Apple Intelligence.
items: Upper Left: white Apple logo above iPhone 17 and oversized metallic-gray 'Pro Max' headline.
Left Column: four outlined feature icons and concise white technical copy.
Right Half: warm, sharply styled brunette portrait emerging from near-black background.
Center: hand-held phone overlaps the portrait and points the camera cluster toward viewer.
Background: deep black seamless studio field with minimal warm rim light and no clutter.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm key light sculpts face, hand, jewelry, velvet, and titanium edges; deep falloff preserves a dramatic luxury mood

technical_specs.render_style: Photorealistic premium smartphone campaign and editorial layout

assets.name: iPhone 17 Pro Max reference
assets.usage: Preserve the exact body finish, camera arrangement, screen proportions, and Apple hardware details.

assets.name: Apple logo
assets.usage: Use only the approved mark at the upper left.

assets.name: brunette beauty model
assets.usage: Maintain the identity only when a licensed portrait reference is supplied; otherwise generate a non-identifiable model with the same styling.

assets.name: vertical feature-sheet typography
assets.usage: Preserve left-column hierarchy and exact visible feature wording when production-approved.

prompt_instructions: Attach approved product, logo, and licensed model references before rendering.
Keep the left feature stack and phone-over-portrait composition; do not invent extra claims or Apple marks.
Visible marketing copy requires a post-render typesetting pass for exact glyph accuracy.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A hyperrealistic Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max advertisement shot in a dark, moody editorial style. A young stylish woman with a warm complexion and soft upswept brunette hair, wearing a dusty mauve velvet off-shoulder mini dress, thigh-high taupe suede heeled boots, and a thin black choker necklace, is captured mid-pose extending her arm forward holding an iPhone 17 Pro Max toward the camera in a confident selfie gesture. The phone — featuring a titanium Desert Sand finish with a flush quad-lens camera system and a edge-to-edge ProMotion display glowing with vivid color — dominates the center of the frame. The composition uses shallow depth of field with tack-sharp focus on the phone screen and extended arm, soft cinematic blur on the background figure. The near-black charcoal background is layered with subtle urban texture — faint graffiti strokes in electric yellow and muted olive barely visible through a heavy dark vignette. Multiple rows of ultra-small all-caps typographic text orbit the phone at different angles reading phrases like "EVERY ANGLE. EVERY MOMENT. EVERY YOU." and "THE SHOT YOU NEVER MISS" — some running vertically, some at 30-degree angles, creating a chaotic yet intentional graphic zine energy. At the upper right, the Apple logo appears in clean brushed silver against the dark background. At the top center, a thin horizontal navigation-style text bar reads "PRO CAMERA · TITANIUM BUILD · BEYOND INTELLIGENCE" in spaced all-caps serif font. A large commanding headline is placed center-right — "CAPTURE" in massive ultra-bold white letters followed by "EVERYTHING" in lighter weight creating dramatic type hierarchy. Small yellow plus (+) symbols and diagonal arrows (↗) scattered throughout as accent details. Bottom left features a bold slogan lockup: "YOUR WORLD. YOUR FRAME." in large bold sans-serif white text with a thin subline reading "The most powerful iPhone ever made. Every selfie is a cinematic moment." The overall lighting is dramatic and directional — a single cold key light from the upper left causing the titanium frame to shimmer, the ProMotion display to glow, and the velvet dress to catch a soft warm sheen against the darkness. Photorealistic. Commercial photography quality. High contrast. 4K resolution. 3:4 vertical format optimized for social media.
prompt.negative_prompt: unapproved logo, incorrect camera cluster, distorted hands, unreadable feature icons, flat light, cluttered background, low resolution, watermark, signature
